title: A second-moment proof of quenched equals annealed for the Potts model on random regular graphs
summary: Ferromagnetic spin models on random regular graphs, such as the Ising and Potts models, have been studied extensively. Several equivalent variational and recursive representations of their limiting pressure are known, and these representations can be used to establish agreement between the quenched and annealed pressures. We give a concise overview of these representations and highlight the connections among the different formulations.
